### `BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge`

- `dlg_bd38bbdac0637283` · battle · — · In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake ⏎ the Set KO Tourney. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ All participants enter with a team of ⏎ three POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The three POKéMON must be lined up in ⏎ the order in which they are to appear. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ During battle, the POKéMON will appear ⏎ one at a time in the preset order. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must ⏎ remain out until the match is decided. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a match remains undecided in ⏎ three turns, it goes to judging. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you wish to interrupt your challenge, ⏎ please save the game. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you don't save, you will not be able ⏎ to continue with your challenge. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you pull off the feat of beating ⏎ seven TRAINERS in succession, ⏎ we will present you with Battle Points.

### `BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules`

- `dlg_d67070c258e2b287` · battle · — · The Set KO Tourney has special rules, ⏎ unlike standard battles. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ First, one battle lasts only ⏎ three turns. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If the outcome is not decided after ⏎ three turns, it goes to judging. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The REFEREE will choose the winner ⏎ based on how the POKéMON battled. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out ⏎ until its battle's outcome is decided.

### `BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules`

- `dlg_0480006b9898f2f6` · battle · — · The first judging factor is “Mind.” ⏎ This factor evaluates how aggressive ⏎ the battlers were. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The judging is based on how often ⏎ the TRAINERS ordered the use of ⏎ offensive moves.

### `BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules`

- `dlg_4f8fe99d75585934` · battle · — · The second judging factor is “Skill.” ⏎ This factor evaluates how effectively ⏎ POKéMON moves were used. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a move worked successfully, ⏎ the Skill rating goes up. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a move failed, the Skill rating ⏎ is lowered. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If it was an offensive move, the Skill ⏎ rating goes up if the move was “super ⏎ effective” and goes down if it was ⏎ “not very effective.” ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The Skill rating will not go up for ⏎ moves such as PROTECT and DETECT. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If the opponent used PROTECT or ⏎ DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to ⏎ hit with a move, its Skill rating will not ⏎ go down.

### `BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules`

- `dlg_cc5538bff5d70c2e` · battle · — · The third judging factor is “Body.” ⏎ This factor is based on how much HP ⏎ remained at the end of a battle. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The rating takes into account how much ⏎ HP a POKéMON had at the start of ⏎ battle, and what remained at the end.

### `BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge`

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics`

- `dlg_7f0a8b93ffbe8492` · battle · — · Here, POKéMON are required to think ⏎ and battle by themselves. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live ⏎ with people behave differently ⏎ depending on their nature.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature`

- `dlg_8615d7a9fa19d73f` · battle · — · Depending on its nature, a POKéMON ⏎ may prefer to attack no matter what. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Another POKéMON may prefer to protect ⏎ itself from any harm. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Yet another may enjoy vexing or ⏎ confounding its foes. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Due to its nature, a POKéMON ⏎ will have favorite moves that it is good ⏎ at using. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It may also dislike certain moves that ⏎ it has trouble using.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves`

- `dlg_dc0196a9ddeb8b54` · battle · — · There are offensive moves that inflict ⏎ direct damage on the foe. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ There are defensive moves that are ⏎ used to prepare for enemy attacks or ⏎ used to heal HP and so on. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ There are also other somewhat-odd ⏎ moves that may enfeeble the foes with ⏎ stat problems including poison and  ⏎ paralysis. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ POKéMON will consider using moves in ⏎ these three categories.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered`

- `dlg_449316b692cac473` · battle · — · When not under command by its TRAINER, ⏎ a POKéMON may be unable to effectively ⏎ use certain moves. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ A POKéMON is not good at using any ⏎ move that it dislikes. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a POKéMON only knows moves that ⏎ do not match its nature, it will often ⏎ be unable to live up to its potential.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger`

- `dlg_0cdc288dd4895edc` · battle · — · Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may ⏎ start using moves that don't match its ⏎ nature when it is in trouble. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly ⏎ in a pinch, watch it carefully.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid`

- `dlg_e51e25dff1fa5e9b` · battle · — · Where the courage of TRAINERS ⏎ is put to the test! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Welcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I am your guide to ⏎ the Battle Quest.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge`

- `dlg_ad319a1d2cbc60df` · battle · — · We await your challenge in the future!

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid`

- `dlg_ef3d093d828dd652` · battle · — · The Battle Quest is a battling ⏎ event in which you must explore ⏎ the PYRAMID and try to reach the top. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ In the PYRAMID are seven floors of ⏎ mazes, all of them filled with not only ⏎ skilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You must enter with three POKéMON, ⏎ none of them holding an item. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ On your ascent, you will be provided ⏎ with a BATTLE BAG for items. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you fail in your challenge, any item ⏎ placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you want to interrupt your ⏎ challenge, you must select “REST” ⏎ and save the game. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you don't save before interrupting, ⏎ you will be disqualified.

### `BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode`

- `dlg_11845312ea3406b1` · battle · — · The PYRAMID offers two courses, ⏎ Level 50 and Open Level. ⏎ Which will you enter?

### `LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt`

- `dlg_d3a038eefa1fffb7` · optional_npc · — · I have here an EGG. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in ⏎ hot sand by the hot springs. ⏎ But that doesn't seem to be enough… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I've heard it would be best if it were ⏎ kept together with POKéMON and ⏎ carried about. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You are a TRAINER, yes? ⏎ And your POKéMON radiate vitality. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ So, what say you? ⏎ Will you take this EGG to hatch?

- `dlg_3798bf4c44734c8a` · optional_npc · — · It happened long, long ago… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The world was wracked by a ferocious ⏎ clash between the POKéMON of the land ⏎ and the POKéMON of the sea… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON of the land raised ⏎ mountains and created continents… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON of the sea raised huge ⏎ waves and carved out oceans… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Their fierce duel raged without end. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The world was engulfed in massive ⏎ infernos and vicious storms. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought ⏎ an end to the calamity. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Light poured from the two ORBS and ⏎ becalmed the enraged adversaries. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The pair, made docile, dove deep into ⏎ the sea where eventually they ⏎ disappeared…

### `MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale`

- `dlg_e078ead96dfcf7bf` · optional_npc · — · It happened long, long ago… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The world was wracked by a ferocious ⏎ clash between the POKéMON of the land ⏎ and the POKéMON of the sea… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON of the land raised ⏎ mountains and created continents… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON of the sea raised huge ⏎ waves and carved out oceans… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Their fierce duel raged without end. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The world was engulfed in massive ⏎ fires and vicious storms. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It was then that the POKéMON of ⏎ the sky descended from a storm. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON, shining a vivid green, ⏎ becalmed the two enraged POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON ⏎ flew off into the wild blue yonder…

### `Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring`

- `dlg_ab5a626641169d85` · optional_npc · — · That RUSTURF TUNNEL there… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ At first, we had a huge work crew boring ⏎ through rock with the latest machinery. ⏎ But, we had to stop. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It turns out that we would have had ⏎ a negative effect on wild POKéMON in ⏎ the area. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ So, we've got nothing to do but loll ⏎ around here doing nothing.

- `dlg_b4b15b306eaf11cd` · optional_npc · — · There's a man digging his way to ⏎ VERDANTURF all by his lonesome. ⏎ He's desperate to get through. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ He says that if he digs little by little ⏎ without using machines, he won't ⏎ disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid ⏎ harming the natural environment. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I wonder if he made it through yet.

- `dlg_1afd0bd85d1ac01f` · optional_npc · — · To get to VERDANTURF without using ⏎ this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the ⏎ sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT, ⏎ then travel through MAUVILLE.

### `Route118_Text_StevenQuestions`

- `dlg_e4e453883683ce8a` · optional_npc · Steven · STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It's me, STEVEN! ⏎ We met in the cave near DEWFORD. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Have you met many kinds of POKéMON ⏎ since I last saw you? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ There are many, many kinds of POKéMON ⏎ in this wide world of ours. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you wanted to raise only your ⏎ favorites, that's fine. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Perhaps you find it more fun to raise ⏎ all sorts of POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ As a TRAINER of POKéMON, ⏎ what do you think? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Of course, it's not any of my business. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It would be nice if we were to meet ⏎ again somewhere.

### `Route119_Text_MayExplainFly`

- `dlg_6be0ed70a0acd49c` · optional_npc · May · MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will ⏎ instantly carry you to any town you've ⏎ already visited. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ But, to use FLY, you have to get ⏎ the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY. ⏎ That's important, so don't forget. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You should FLY home and visit ⏎ LITTLEROOT for a change. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I bet your mom's worried about you, ⏎ {PLAYER}{KUN}. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Well, let's meet again somewhere!

- `dlg_83a72594b4c34bcc` · optional_npc · Brendan · BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where ⏎ you've been looking for POKéMON? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Let me see how good you got. ⏎ I'll test you! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Now! ⏎ It's a battle, so battle!

### `Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou`

- `dlg_6f04353d49eb36ad` · optional_npc · — · SCOTT: Hahahah! ⏎ Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I just passed by a TRAINER riding ⏎ a BIKE. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you? ⏎ It was pretty obvious that you did. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The kid looked really upset with ⏎ a face all red from anger. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I sure seem to run into you often. ⏎ Are you off to FORTREE GYM next? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I expect that you'll do well at the GYM. ⏎ Well, I'll be seeing you!

### `Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym`

- `dlg_0e6554b898ee7d0c` · optional_npc · — · … … … … … … ⏎ … … … … … Beep! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ SCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Just as I thought, you won at ⏎ the FORTREE GYM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Your strength… ⏎ Perhaps you really are the TRAINER ⏎ that I've been searching for. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Remember, you have a fan in me. ⏎ I'll be cheering from the sidelines. ⏎ Keep up the great work! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ … … … … … … ⏎ … … … … … Click!

### `SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1`

### `SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2`

- `dlg_32272938d5a7ccb1` · optional_npc · — · SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in ⏎ the crater of a volcano. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you look up at the sky, the lip of ⏎ the crater is also visible. ⏎ So, all you see is the sky in a circle. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ But that's what makes the sky above ⏎ SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.

### `SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild`

- `dlg_c8dff0ed3ecabdd6` · optional_npc · — · The weather was clear this morning, ⏎ but… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, ⏎ rain started falling in sheets, and ⏎ there was thunder and lightning, too. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The weather just went completely ⏎ wild! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Is all of this because of those ⏎ POKéMON?

### `SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe`

- `dlg_2eb7f1b6277a7dc5` · optional_npc · — · STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting… ⏎ GROUDON… And KYOGRE… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The two super-ancient POKéMON ⏎ were awakened from a long sleep… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ And now they are smashing each other ⏎ with their uncontrollable energy… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ …{PLAYER}{KUN}. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You being here now I'll take to mean ⏎ that you're prepared to become ⏎ involved in this crisis. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Well, then, there's someone that ⏎ I'd like you to meet. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Come with me, please.

### `SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon`

- `dlg_585a3ab7c24ab2ed` · optional_npc · — · STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make ⏎ you think POKéMON are to be feared? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ But that's not true. ⏎ POKéMON are really more… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ …Why am I asking you this? ⏎ You already know.

- `dlg_78ae671625b2498d` · optional_npc · Juan · Let me ask you. ⏎ Did you know? ⏎ Ah, I should not be so coy. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It was I who taught WALLACE everything ⏎ there is to know about POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Once, I had given up my position as ⏎ the GYM LEADER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE ⏎ with the GYM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ However, a compelling reason arose for ⏎ me to make a comeback. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Ah, but enough chatter. ⏎ Let us begin our match, shall we? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Please, you shall bear witness to ⏎ our artistry. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ A grand illusion of water sculpted ⏎ by POKéMON and myself!

### `SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat`

- `dlg_947d797032f9e13a` · optional_npc · Juan · Ahahaha, excellent! ⏎ Very well, you are the winner. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ From you, I sense the brilliant shine ⏎ of skill that will overcome all. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ However, compared with me or even ⏎ WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Perhaps I should make you a loan ⏎ of my outfit? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ … … … … … … ⏎ … … … … … … ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Hahaha, I merely jest! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Rather than my clothes, I shall reward ⏎ you with this, the RAIN BADGE!

### `LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests`

- `dlg_dd15be6fb0d5aa0d` · system · — · A POKéMON CONTEST involves four ⏎ TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each ⏎ in competitive judging. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ A CONTEST has two stages of judging, ⏎ primary and secondary. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Primary judging is a popularity poll ⏎ involving the audience. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Secondary judging features appeals ⏎ by the POKéMON using their moves. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Plan appeals carefully to earn the ⏎ most attention of the JUDGE and ⏎ excite the audience. ⏎ Do your best to stand out. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The primary and secondary scores are ⏎ added at the end. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON garnering the highest ⏎ score is declared the winner.

- `dlg_acac669db23bd363` · system · — · There are four ranks of POKéMON ⏎ CONTESTS. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ NORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER ⏎ are the four ranks. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ In the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may ⏎ enter. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank ⏎ CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank ⏎ in the same category. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner ⏎ can move up to the HYPER Rank, and ⏎ a HYPER Rank winner can advance to ⏎ the MASTER Rank in the same category. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ A POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank ⏎ may compete in the MASTER Rank as ⏎ often as its TRAINER wants.

- `dlg_0a5d222f799f3ee5` · battle · — · In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, ⏎ there is one crucial rule that must ⏎ be obeyed. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ TRAINERS are permitted only to switch ⏎ their POKéMON in and out. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to ⏎ command their POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The POKéMON are to behave according ⏎ to their nature and battle on their own. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You must put your trust in your ⏎ POKéMON and watch over them. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you achieve the honor of beating ⏎ three TRAINERS in succession, ⏎ we will present you with a prize. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you want to interrupt your ⏎ challenge, please save the game. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you don't save before interrupting, ⏎ you will be disqualified.

### `SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent`

- `dlg_91e08afc97ef4a6d` · battle · — · Here at the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT, ⏎ we hold Battle Swap events ⏎ using rental POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ First, you will be loaned three ⏎ POKéMON specifically for this event. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Using the supplied rental POKéMON, ⏎ you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you win, you are permitted to trade ⏎ one of your rental POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Repeat this cycle of battling and ⏎ trading--if you win three times in ⏎ a row, you will earn a fine prize. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you want to interrupt your ⏎ challenge, please save the game. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you don't save before interrupting, ⏎ you will be disqualified.

### `SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules`

- `dlg_a0839bdfe5586339` · battle · — · In a Battle Swap event, you may use ⏎ only three POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Whether you are renting or swapping, ⏎ your team may not have two or more ⏎ of the same POKéMON.

### `SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules`

- `dlg_3345d4cd15ec0741` · battle · — · You may swap POKéMON only with ⏎ the TRAINER you have just defeated. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You may swap for only those POKéMON ⏎ used by the beaten TRAINER.

### `SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes`

- `dlg_d34fefc6356f66f8` · battle · — · There are two key points to be aware ⏎ of when swapping POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ First, when swapping, you can't check ⏎ the stats of the POKéMON you are ⏎ about to receive. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Second, the POKéMON on your team ⏎ are lined up in sequence, depending on ⏎ the order in which you rented them. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ This sequence remains unchanged ⏎ even when swaps are made.

- `dlg_00b2bfec90344139` · battle · — · Which heading do you want to read?

### `VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules`

- `dlg_7753d71413ed7bfa` · battle · — · Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, ⏎ POKéMON are required to think and ⏎ battle by themselves. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live ⏎ with people behave differently ⏎ depending on their nature.

### `VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules`

- `dlg_c8ed08da52c109ab` · battle · — · Depending on its nature, a POKéMON ⏎ may prefer to attack no matter what. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Another POKéMON may prefer to protect ⏎ itself from any harm. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Yet another may enjoy vexing or ⏎ confounding its foes. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Depending on its nature, a POKéMON ⏎ will have favorite moves that it is good ⏎ at using. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It may also dislike certain moves that ⏎ it has trouble using.

### `VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules`

- `dlg_9ae5c5fc9bc9dae1` · battle · — · There are offensive moves that inflict ⏎ direct damage on the foe. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ There are defensive moves that are ⏎ used to prepare for enemy attacks or ⏎ used to heal HP and so on. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ There are also other somewhat-odd ⏎ moves that may enfeeble the foes with ⏎ stat problems including poison and  ⏎ paralysis. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ POKéMON will consider using moves in ⏎ these three categories.

### `VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules`

- `dlg_e757d72bb898aa5c` · battle · — · When not under command by its TRAINER, ⏎ a POKéMON may be unable to effectively ⏎ use certain moves. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ A POKéMON is not good at using any ⏎ move that it dislikes. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a POKéMON only knows moves that ⏎ do not match its nature, it will often ⏎ be unable to live up to its potential.

### `VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules`

- `dlg_f343c0338c4e0082` · battle · — · Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may ⏎ start using moves that don't match its ⏎ nature when it is in trouble. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly ⏎ in a pinch, watch it carefully.

### `BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules`

- `dlg_2afbc002ef0b9071` · battle · — · At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of ⏎ your opponents will be adjusted to ⏎ match the levels of your POKéMON. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ However, no TRAINER you face will ⏎ have any POKéMON below Level 30.

### `CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstTime`

- `dlg_b09bb4a43a49e1dc` · system · — · On the top floor, there are two ⏎ rooms. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ First, the room on the left. ⏎ It's the UNION ROOM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You may link up with TRAINERS ⏎ around you who have also entered ⏎ the UNION ROOM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ With them, you may do things like ⏎ chat, battle, and trade. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Second, the room on the right is ⏎ the DIRECT CORNER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You may trade or battle POKéMON ⏎ with your friends in this room. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If the Wireless Adapter isn't ⏎ connected, you may still link up ⏎ using a GBA Game Link cable. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If that is the case, you must go ⏎ to the DIRECT CORNER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I hope you enjoy the Wireless  ⏎ Communication System.

### `CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub`

- `dlg_cbc18b660bb26e13` · system · — · Let me explain how the POKéMON ⏎ WIRELESS CLUB works. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ On this, the top floor, there are ⏎ two rooms. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ First, the room on the left. ⏎ It's the UNION ROOM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You may link up with TRAINERS ⏎ around you who have also entered ⏎ the UNION ROOM. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ With them, you may do things like ⏎ chat, battle, and trade. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Second, the room on the right is ⏎ the DIRECT CORNER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You may trade or battle POKéMON ⏎ with your friends in this room. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Sometimes, you may not be able to ⏎ find your friends in the UNION ROOM ⏎ or the DIRECT CORNER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ In that case, please move closer ⏎ to your friends. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If the Wireless Adapter isn't ⏎ connected, you may still link up ⏎ using a GBA Game Link cable. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If that is the case, you must go ⏎ to the DIRECT CORNER. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I hope you enjoy the Wireless  ⏎ Communication System.

- `dlg_a6f868a6ab922bc4` · system · — · Did you know that you can go from ⏎ here a long way in that direction ⏎ without changing direction? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I might even be able to roll ⏎ that way. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Do you think your POKéMON will ⏎ want to roll, too? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I can teach one the move ROLLOUT ⏎ if you'd like.

### `MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach`

- `dlg_e6fa5643f47e3c5e` · system · — · There's a move that gets stronger ⏎ when you keep using it in a row. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It's a BUG-type move, and it is ⏎ wickedly cool. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It's called FURY CUTTER. ⏎ Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?

### `MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach`

- `dlg_018b5cb21027c9e7` · system · — · Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN ⏎ POWER to stay awake. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ She should just take a nap like I do, ⏎ and SLEEP TALK. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I can teach your POKéMON how to ⏎ SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?

### `MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach`

- `dlg_3ed224933477fa35` · system · — · When I see the wide world from up ⏎ here on the roof… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I think about how nice it would be ⏎ if there were more than just one me ⏎ so I could enjoy all sorts of lives. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Of course it's not possible. ⏎ Giggle… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I know! - `dlg_7c2c9f7a256f446e` · system · — · I can't do this anymore! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ It's utterly hopeless! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER, ⏎ so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM ⏎ no matter how hard I try! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Argh! ### `MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach`

- `dlg_aaefd71e7d6d4760` · system · — · Sigh… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really ⏎ lovably admirable. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ But that also means I have many ⏎ rivals for his attention. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ He's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE. ⏎ I couldn't even catch his eye. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Please, let me teach your POKéMON ⏎ the move DOUBLE-EDGE!

### `Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle`

- `dlg_187a5ce86301c36c` · trainer · — · There probably is no stronger TRAINER ⏎ than you!

### `Route128_Text_WayneIntro`

- `dlg_f6a78f4de98146d9` · trainer · — · I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I ⏎ caught myself a POKéMON that knows ⏎ the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.

### `Route128_Text_WayneDefeat`

- `dlg_33b8343dd507fd66` · trainer · — · I'm crestfallen!

### `Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle`

- `dlg_90314c839420f710` · trainer · — · Awww, phooey! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but ⏎ I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!

### `Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro`

- `dlg_047aff2685a76ce8` · trainer · — · You're looking awfully tough. ⏎ I wonder if I can win?

### `Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat`

- `dlg_5dc521e7f34fc554` · trainer · — · Ouch! ⏎ I guess it was impossible to win.

### `Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle`

- `dlg_ff98e69011de919b` · trainer · — · There are tough TRAINERS galore ⏎ around EVER GRANDE. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Do you think I may be out ⏎ of my league?

### `Route128_Text_CarleeIntro`

- `dlg_612baf30726f7940` · trainer · — · The sunlight seems to be more harsh ⏎ in this area.

### `Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat`

- `dlg_8aeebaa176950591` · trainer · — · I couldn't see very well because of ⏎ the sun's glare.

### `Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle`

- `dlg_77767885faf31233` · trainer · — · I should go back soon. ⏎ I need to reapply my sunscreen.

### `Route129_Text_ChaseIntro`

- `dlg_509fb9a36700f0b2` · trainer · — · This is my first triathlon. ⏎ I'm all tense and nervous!

### `Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat`

- `dlg_065f16b173b54f26` · trainer · — · Wroooaaar! ⏎ I failed to win!

### `Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle`

- `dlg_3c6d3859fe2bd397` · trainer · — · If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to ⏎ give it my all.

### `Route129_Text_AllisonIntro`

- `dlg_1d64e64e5c46a808` · trainer · — · I'm in the middle of a triathlon, ⏎ but, sure, why don't we battle?

### `Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat`

- `dlg_c89814c16451f142` · trainer · — · I was sure I'd win!

### `Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle`

- `dlg_fbfa615a2ba39bf2` · trainer · — · Do you know what's the greatest thing ⏎ about triathlons? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Testing the limits of your own ⏎ strength and endurance against ⏎ Mother Nature!

### `Route129_Text_ReedIntro`

- `dlg_e7e0d687a027a327` · trainer · — · Say hey, hey! ⏎ Let's get on with it!

### `Route129_Text_ReedDefeat`

- `dlg_b212a562d7bb6a5b` · trainer · — · Beat, I'm beaten. ⏎ That's it, done!

### `Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle`

- `dlg_3eb13bfdb25ee33f` · trainer · — · There's nothing for a loser. ⏎ Time for me to beat it home.

### `Route129_Text_TishaIntro`

- `dlg_c0e44522a196c54c` · trainer · — · What's the hurry? ⏎ Let's take it slow and easy.

### `Route129_Text_TishaDefeat`

- `dlg_1d5c23e35fcaf113` · trainer · — · Oh, my. ⏎ I wanted to relax a little more…

### `Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle`

- `dlg_6cc1f349d07383dd` · trainer · — · Don't you hate making mistakes when ⏎ you're in a rush? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ That's why I try to take things ⏎ slowly.

### `Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro`

- `dlg_b2bb6933e75c874a` · trainer · — · Surfing isn't as easy as it seems, ⏎ isn't that right?

### `Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat`

- `dlg_0b4c91d90accbb13` · trainer · — · Winning sure isn't easy.

### `Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle`

- `dlg_5f0ddd7532211208` · trainer · — · You have your sights on the POKéMON ⏎ LEAGUE? Keep at it!

### `Route130_Text_RodneyIntro`

- `dlg_790d2e0962ff7f06` · trainer · — · What a surprise! I didn't expect to ⏎ see a TRAINER out in the sea. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I think we should battle!

### `Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat`

- `dlg_6623b1e9e69d0aa8` · trainer · — · This kid's awfully tough…

### `Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle`

- `dlg_aa4e6d67aa728714` · trainer · — · Your eyes have that look of someone ⏎ who's experienced harsh challenges ⏎ and won. It suits you well!

### `Route130_Text_KatieIntro`

- `dlg_d866026c647dc162` · trainer · — · In the deep blue sea, ⏎ my shattered blue heart finds ⏎ comfort among waves.

### `Route130_Text_KatieDefeat`

- `dlg_a4b56d471a289f87` · trainer · — · Like the vast blue sea, ⏎ the world of POKéMON spans ⏎ depths beyond belief.

### `Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle`

- `dlg_3a1d5565e1b2a8cc` · trainer · — · The world's children dream ⏎ of one day becoming ⏎ the POKéMON CHAMPION.

### `Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro`

- `dlg_5ae705b934018efd` · trainer · — · Floating on the open sea like this… ⏎ It's peaceful.

### `Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat`

- `dlg_4c14822ed0162406` · trainer · — · I needed to be a little less peaceful!

### `Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle`

- `dlg_b0de859dd9c98141` · trainer · — · Swimming and battling like this… ⏎ I'm one happy guy…

### `Route131_Text_RichardIntro`

- `dlg_ca51552e611d22ef` · trainer · — · The sea is teeming with POKéMON. ⏎ It's not easy swimming, I tell you.

### `Route131_Text_RichardDefeat`

- `dlg_d29ff79c2abc16bb` · trainer · — · POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are ⏎ seriously tough…

### `Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle`

- `dlg_7873f2953cf163a8` · trainer · — · Gasp… Gasp… ⏎ I'm wiped out… ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ The going's easy. It's the leaving ⏎ that's the hard part. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Will I have any energy left to make ⏎ the return trip?

### `Route131_Text_HermanIntro`

- `dlg_66d5400b3c643c75` · trainer · — · The sea… The sea… The sea… ⏎ The sea as far as these eyes can see! ⏎ I'm sick and tired of the sea!

### `Route131_Text_HermanDefeat`

- `dlg_a232f238ac2d47ad` · trainer · — · Bleah!

### `Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle`

- `dlg_d6cbfbb8db24735d` · trainer · — · Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I'm a born swimmer! ⏎ That's what I am.

### `Route131_Text_SusieIntro`

- `dlg_f7c0d5cad5f58851` · trainer · — · Hi, sweetie, wait! ⏎ We should battle, you and I!

### `Route131_Text_SusieDefeat`

- `dlg_24466e1eb02202fe` · trainer · — · You're tough in spite of the way ⏎ you look!

### `Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle`

- `dlg_6c12fc73a7552879` · trainer · — · Did you see a guy over there who whines ⏎ that he's bored of the sea? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ That's all talk. ⏎ He's hopelessly in love with the sea!

### `Route131_Text_KaraIntro`

- `dlg_6c9c0976c48564ec` · trainer · — · Why do men love bathing suits so much? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ They all ogle me!

### `Route131_Text_KaraDefeat`

- `dlg_68fa3b70ed344e71` · trainer · — · I'm out of my depth!

### `Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle`

- `dlg_4ab39c84380c7b41` · trainer · — · Maybe it's not my bathing suit that ⏎ makes men look. It must be my beauty!

### `Route131_Text_ReliIntro`

- `dlg_eed4da0eaca4718b` · trainer · — · RELI: We'll work together as siblings ⏎ to take you on!

### `Route131_Text_ReliDefeat`

- `dlg_02d6b50f7e82c4ca` · trainer · — · RELI: We couldn't win even though we ⏎ worked together…

### `Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle`

- `dlg_30d68658beab8b3c` · trainer · — · RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are ⏎ together with the sea and POKéMON from ⏎ the time they are born.

### `Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons`

- `dlg_d9c55a747a8ddd96` · trainer · — · RELI: You don't have two POKéMON? ⏎ We can't enjoy a battle, then.

### `Route131_Text_IanIntro`

- `dlg_0b87f16d98eafcca` · trainer · — · IAN: I'm doing my best together with ⏎ my sis!

### `Route131_Text_IanDefeat`

- `dlg_de1fe3d7690fb5c8` · trainer · — · IAN: I did my best with my sis, ⏎ but we still couldn't win…

### `Route131_Text_IanPostBattle`

- `dlg_0a970cc862050c4b` · trainer · — · IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is ⏎ a floating town? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ So, wherever there is the sea, ⏎ that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!

### `Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons`

- `dlg_341996f28cdabda5` · trainer · — · IAN: If you have two POKéMON, ⏎ we'll take you on!

### `Route131_Text_TaliaIntro`

- `dlg_cfe288bfaea1e128` · trainer · — · If you can beat me, I'll give you some ⏎ great information!

### `Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat`

- `dlg_772cc254723a756a` · trainer · — · Oh? ⏎ Did I lose?

### `Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle`

- `dlg_45e7496a6d673c9a` · trainer · — · There is an odd place nearby. ⏎ There's a huge tower there. ⏎ Why don't you go take a look?

### `Route131_Text_KevinIntro`

- `dlg_5cae3df597c3e397` · trainer · — · The people of PACIFIDLOG are ⏎ a peaceful bunch. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ They never get angry. ⏎ That goes for me, too.

### `Route131_Text_KevinDefeat`

- `dlg_a1697f68a14af3a2` · trainer · — · Oops!

### `Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle`

- `dlg_83b30426db9dbb13` · trainer · — · Tch! …Oh, wait. ⏎ I'm not angry. Honestly! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ But, boy, you're strong! ⏎ Hahaha!

### `Route132_Text_GilbertIntro`

- `dlg_1fd5770baf110594` · trainer · — · I used to catch colds all the time as ⏎ a kid, but I became totally fit after ⏎ I started swimming.

### `Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat`

- `dlg_c3b9cab32e611aee` · trainer · — · I crave more power…

### `Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle`

- `dlg_6d047ae97a55f409` · trainer · — · TRAINERS travel the fields and ⏎ mountains, so they must be fit, too.

### `Route132_Text_DanaIntro`

- `dlg_a6a12ed19116086b` · trainer · — · I try not to swim where the currents ⏎ are too strong.

### `Route132_Text_DanaDefeat`

- `dlg_2201f88a53c4954b` · trainer · — · Oh, please, no!

### `Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle`

- `dlg_403ce4bb4ea1bf71` · trainer · — · If I get swept away, I'll lose all my ⏎ sense of place…

### `Route132_Text_RonaldIntro`

- `dlg_789aebae9c6c57eb` · trainer · — · Win or lose, you'll never know until ⏎ you try!

### `Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat`

- `dlg_c3d819920d9b414d` · trainer · — · Waah! ⏎ I sank in defeat!

### `Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle`

- `dlg_cd513f2beb569a63` · trainer · — · I never battle when I know I'll win. ⏎ I like to battle at the razor's edge of ⏎ victory and defeat!

### `Route132_Text_KiyoIntro`

- `dlg_f5976c177c5088e8` · trainer · — · I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. ⏎ How could you possibly beat me?

### `Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat`

- `dlg_0d90cac2e14c5266` · trainer · — · I lose. ⏎ I will concede defeat.

### `Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle`

- `dlg_3eb761e106860c84` · trainer · — · Urggh… ⏎ You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours ⏎ a day, don't you?

### `Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro`

- `dlg_e4fa96563fd490a7` · trainer · — · I'm always with my husband, ⏎ but I can win even without him.

### `Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat`

- `dlg_bf4d253beaf06f01` · trainer · — · Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.

### `Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle`

- `dlg_72b57f2ee2fb939e` · trainer · — · That young man over there looks just ⏎ like my husband when he was young. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ He's making me blush!

### `Route132_Text_JonathanIntro`

- `dlg_24eb02eea2046749` · trainer · — · Someone's been watching me intently. ⏎ Was it you?

### `Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat`

- `dlg_db26983b29de462d` · trainer · — · Wow! ⏎ That's pretty strong, all right!

### `Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle`

- `dlg_36e52fe675319ea0` · trainer · — · I can't shake this feeling that ⏎ someone's watching me. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I can't concentrate!

### `Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro`

- `dlg_52463f03fa5539d3` · trainer · — · Now where could my wife have gone? ⏎ I'm always with her. ⏎ I wonder if I can win on my own.

- `dlg_6e099bc7532dea3c` · trainer · — · Ah, I see that I couldn't manage ⏎ to win on my own after all.

- `dlg_6fbc9db50fe1428c` · trainer · — · My wife must be looking for me. ⏎ I'd best go find her right away.

### `Route132_Text_DarcyIntro`

- `dlg_af8427c83b680a85` · trainer · — · I liked training here by myself. ⏎ It's awful that all these people came!

### `Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat`

- `dlg_8269e1cda143d30c` · trainer · — · Okay! I won't complain about other ⏎ people being here.

### `Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle`

- `dlg_f099c6f4c2cc259d` · trainer · — · I suppose I can partner up with that ⏎ old man and challenge that other team.

### `Route133_Text_FranklinIntro`

- `dlg_0b8ad8105b821f59` · trainer · — · Did the currents carry you here, too? ⏎ This must have been fated. ⏎ Let's battle!

### `Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat`

- `dlg_ee53782351517cb0` · trainer · — · Strong! ⏎ Too much so!

### `Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle`

- `dlg_1c362b7bd0280fba` · trainer · — · It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER ⏎ like you would drift here… ⏎ I must be cursed…

### `Route133_Text_DebraIntro`

- `dlg_bef962979ac161d7` · trainer · — · I've led a life of woe and misery… ⏎ I've been cast away, and this is where ⏎ I've drifted…

### `Route133_Text_DebraDefeat`

- `dlg_cfbac7e61075e653` · trainer · — · Another loss…

### `Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle`

- `dlg_5e9094c4e3c7e99d` · trainer · — · A life adrift… ⏎ I don't want it anymore!

### `Route133_Text_LindaIntro`

- `dlg_1419d247d1168405` · trainer · — · Welcome! ⏎ I've been expecting you!

### `Route133_Text_LindaDefeat`

- `dlg_3435b4768ab28fda` · trainer · — · No! Please!

### `Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle`

- `dlg_bc8602aea029c3e5` · trainer · — · A strong child TRAINER… ⏎ That's so annoying!

### `Route133_Text_WarrenIntro`

- `dlg_7d655c2e380c1f88` · trainer · — · I want to win like everyone else, but I ⏎ won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.

### `Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat`

- `dlg_fa14e1f695cb91df` · trainer · — · Darn it! ⏎ My way is still too slack!

### `Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle`

- `dlg_eb0d16f1af4ce214` · trainer · — · It's way more fun to do things the way ⏎ I want than to be like everybody else. ⏎ I mean, that's obvious!

### `Route133_Text_BeckIntro`

- `dlg_a8813743d4654d7d` · trainer · — · I came all the way out here with my ⏎ BIRD POKéMON.

### `Route133_Text_BeckDefeat`

- `dlg_b4cc329508abc97c` · trainer · — · You… ⏎ You're stunningly cool!

### `Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle`

- `dlg_bcec8c9372067699` · trainer · — · I'd like to go back to FORTREE, ⏎ but I've grown to like this place, too.

### `Route133_Text_MollieIntro`

- `dlg_48f54f73e91ba3f0` · trainer · — · I must have battled thousands ⏎ of times. I've lost count.

### `Route133_Text_MollieDefeat`

- `dlg_bee578ad00994ee5` · trainer · — · I may have lost thousands of times, ⏎ but a loss still stings.

### `Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle`

- `dlg_8079f4fdf4b68ab6` · trainer · — · Keep at this, youngster. So you can ⏎ become like my husband and me.

### `Route133_Text_ConorIntro`

- `dlg_b4fc733e44a3e9c0` · trainer · — · Young people are too happy to go with ⏎ the flow. They're without direction.

### `Route133_Text_ConorDefeat`

- `dlg_c4bd4af263aa327d` · trainer · — · You have a firm sense of purpose.

### `Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle`

- `dlg_e61317b4f70b8ecf` · trainer · — · Don't let others lead you astray. ⏎ Don't lose direction as you grow older.

### `Route134_Text_JackIntro`

- `dlg_ba1a6e1bdfc3485f` · trainer · — · Even those POKéMON that can swim are ⏎ carried along by the rapid currents.

### `Route134_Text_JackDefeat`

- `dlg_95c3c985b1f5196b` · trainer · — · Aiyeeeeh!

### `Route134_Text_JackPostBattle`

- `dlg_a63e1caf63d739f9` · trainer · — · I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running ⏎ currents around these parts.

### `Route134_Text_LaurelIntro`

- `dlg_db44b0430f74f58d` · trainer · — · My LUVDISC are looking for a fun ⏎ match. Will you join us?

### `Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat`

- `dlg_8789cafec4915d42` · trainer · — · Oopsie!

### `Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle`

- `dlg_f9ce3bea4a8534b8` · trainer · — · There's a collector who's after ⏎ the SCALES of LUVDISC.

### `Route134_Text_AlexIntro`

- `dlg_e94e43c5c72d9883` · trainer · — · Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang! ⏎ It's time for a match!

### `Route134_Text_AlexDefeat`

- `dlg_a9d6a1af82018fda` · trainer · — · Tuckered out again…

### `Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle`

- `dlg_14850ab221008b61` · trainer · — · My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after ⏎ a long flight…

### `Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro`

- `dlg_39352030630f3fb1` · trainer · — · You're a POKéMON TRAINER. ⏎ No need for words. We battle now.

### `Route134_Text_HitoshiDefeat`

- `dlg_0dcdf60cc7fb384f` · trainer · — · … … … … … … ⏎ … … … … … …

### `Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle`

- `dlg_609e7253c8390e88` · trainer · — · It was I who challenged you, and yet ⏎ I lost. I am deeply shamed…

### `Route134_Text_AaronIntro`

- `dlg_cd7c05bb523c770f` · trainer · — · The savage tide in this area serves to ⏎ make us stronger than ever.

### `Route134_Text_AaronDefeat`

- `dlg_789ce531cf6f03ef` · trainer · — · I willingly concede defeat.

### `Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle`

- `dlg_265876332c3d449b` · trainer · — · We will return for more training at ⏎ METEOR FALLS. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ If you'd like, you should go, too. ⏎ It will definitely toughen you up!

### `Route134_Text_KelvinIntro`

- `dlg_604d0f2c137cc067` · trainer · — · O-our boat! ⏎ The tide carried it away!

### `Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat`

- `dlg_68da7b35b8944c85` · trainer · — · Awawawawah! ⏎ Please, stop! Please!

### `Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle`

- `dlg_ba1bb3dba2f6bd27` · trainer · — · If we can't SURF, how are we supposed ⏎ to get home? ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON ⏎ can still SURF, but it feels wrong.

- `dlg_ec0162c86c8e9418` · trainer · — · Can your POKéMON dodge our ⏎ lightning-quick attacks?

### `Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat`

- `dlg_c4a8d405dea7c0ab` · trainer · — · I never knew such a technique existed! ⏎ You've defeated us thoroughly.

### `Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle`

- `dlg_3db5a78bffd34278` · trainer · — · I haven't lost my passion for speed. ⏎ I will try harder.

### `Route134_Text_ReynaIntro`

- `dlg_e2da3daa7fa699cc` · trainer · — · My POKéMON can't be taken down ⏎ easily!

### `Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat`

- `dlg_02557f570a5a5a99` · trainer · — · You're kidding! ⏎ Explain how I lost!

### `Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle`

- `dlg_23cea628cffc19b4` · trainer · — · Haha! ⏎ You won, all right! ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ I'll work my way back up by taking on ⏎ TRAINERS I happen to meet!

### `Route134_Text_HudsonIntro`

- `dlg_5ac89e7ba3e24236` · trainer · — · Listen, have you seen another SAILOR ⏎ around here?

### `Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat`

- `dlg_75635353d22455b6` · trainer · — · Now, that's something!

### `Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle`

- `dlg_4efd9b8d50047cc0` · trainer · — · Our boat drifted out to sea. ⏎ [PAGE] ⏎ My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm ⏎ worried about him.

## `src/data/pokemon/pokedex_text.h`

### `gDummyPokedexText`

- `dlg_6dd4b4eff1e7019b` · menu · — · This is a newly discovered POKéMON. ⏎ It is currently under investigation. ⏎ No detailed information is available ⏎ at this time.

### `gBulbasaurPokedexText`

- `dlg_70d4e11cfc7dc8b0` · menu · — · BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright ⏎ sunlight. There is a seed on its back. ⏎ By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed ⏎ grows progressively larger.

### `gIvysaurPokedexText`

- `dlg_4806f247f5204994` · menu · — · To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs ⏎ grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in ⏎ the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into ⏎ a large flower.

### `gVenusaurPokedexText`

- `dlg_e8b9bfdbfa3198b0` · menu · — · VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid ⏎ colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and ⏎ sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the ⏎ emotions of people.

### `gCharmanderPokedexText`

- `dlg_10ac8baa1b00e17d` · menu · — · The flame that burns at the tip of its ⏎ tail is an indication of its emotions. ⏎ The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is ⏎ happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

### `gCharmeleonPokedexText`

- `dlg_02317e347d61c97f` · menu · — · Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. ⏎ If it encounters a strong enemy, it ⏎ becomes agitated, and the flame on its ⏎ tail flares with a bluish white color.

### `gCharizardPokedexText`

- `dlg_50dde6f53117d2c5` · menu · — · A CHARIZARD flies about in search of ⏎ strong opponents. It breathes intense ⏎ flames that can melt any material. However, ⏎ it will never torch a weaker foe.

### `gSquirtlePokedexText`

- `dlg_0e669aa4af94f537` · menu · — · Its shell is not just for protection. ⏎ Its rounded shape and the grooves on its ⏎ surface minimize resistance in water, ⏎ enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.

### `gWartortlePokedexText`

- `dlg_dc57531b49b90bd5` · menu · — · Its large tail is covered with rich, thick ⏎ fur that deepens in color with age. ⏎ The scratches on its shell are evidence ⏎ of this POKéMON's toughness in battle.

### `gBlastoisePokedexText`

- `dlg_d3d3835bb2509303` · menu · — · The waterspouts that protrude from its ⏎ shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of ⏎ water can precisely nail tin cans from ⏎ a distance of over 160 feet.

### `gCaterpiePokedexText`

- `dlg_6745c16f9d0ec0df` · menu · — · Its voracious appetite compels it to ⏎ devour leaves bigger than itself without ⏎ hesitation. It releases a terribly strong ⏎ odor from its antennae.

### `gMetapodPokedexText`

- `dlg_dff8e7deb1c3a2be` · menu · — · Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. ⏎ A METAPOD does not move very much ⏎ because it is preparing its soft innards ⏎ for evolution inside the shell.

### `gButterfreePokedexText`

- `dlg_5f1e8c489e73ae08` · menu · — · It has a superior ability to search for ⏎ delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, ⏎ extract, and carry honey from flowers ⏎ blooming over six miles away.

### `gWeedlePokedexText`

- `dlg_7336ef2f4e3d963f` · menu · — · A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense ⏎ of smell. It distinguishes its favorite ⏎ kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by ⏎ sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

### `gKakunaPokedexText`

- `dlg_475e8fa297d4a35e` · menu · — · It remains virtually immobile while it ⏎ clings to a tree. However, on the inside, ⏎ it busily prepares for evolution. This is ⏎ evident from how hot its shell becomes.

### `gBeedrillPokedexText`

- `dlg_7081a94696545acb` · menu · — · A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. ⏎ For safety reasons, no one should  ⏎ ever approach its nest. If angered, ⏎ they will attack in a swarm.

### `gPidgeyPokedexText`

- `dlg_45e19ba7ec649387` · menu · — · It has an extremely sharp sense of ⏎ direction. It can unerringly return home to ⏎ its nest, however far it may be removed ⏎ from its familiar surroundings.

### `gPidgeottoPokedexText`

- `dlg_e717702bf23dd974` · menu · — · This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its ⏎ large territory. If its living space is ⏎ violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly ⏎ punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

### `gPidgeotPokedexText`

- `dlg_9e56eb0a8d247c46` · menu · — · This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy ⏎ feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated ⏎ by the beautiful feathers on its head that ⏎ they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

### `gRattataPokedexText`

- `dlg_6f0ccbae8c74d936` · menu · — · A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. ⏎ Even while it is asleep, it constantly ⏎ moves its ears and listens for danger. ⏎ It will make its nest anywhere.

### `gRaticatePokedexText`

- `dlg_4c592c29b71cec90` · menu · — · A RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily. ⏎ To keep them ground down, it gnaws on ⏎ rocks and logs. It may even chew on the ⏎ walls of houses.

### `gSpearowPokedexText`

- `dlg_0a88d3eca6f25b32` · menu · — · Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile ⏎ away. If its high, keening cry is heard ⏎ echoing all around, it is a sign that they ⏎ are warning each other of danger.

### `gFearowPokedexText`

- `dlg_3e7f650aeb9d8897` · menu · — · Its long neck and elongated beak are ⏎ ideal for catching prey in soil or water. ⏎ It deftly moves this extended and skinny ⏎ beak to pluck prey.

### `gEkansPokedexText`

- `dlg_76deb24cbe97de43` · menu · — · An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while ⏎ it rests. This position allows it to quickly ⏎ respond to an enemy from any direction ⏎ with a threat from its upraised head.

### `gArbokPokedexText`

- `dlg_1e590decf7c06d7f` · menu · — · This POKéMON has a terrifically strong ⏎ constricting power. It can even flatten ⏎ steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body ⏎ around its foe, escaping is impossible.

### `gPikachuPokedexText`

- `dlg_61631d3b25c3d0c1` · menu · — · It stores electricity in the electric sacs ⏎ on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up ⏎ energy in a burst, the electric power is ⏎ equal to a lightning bolt.

### `gRaichuPokedexText`

- `dlg_da951f0eb5f3335a` · menu · — · If it stores too much electricity, its ⏎ behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, ⏎ it occasionally discharges excess energy ⏎ and calms itself down.

### `gSandshrewPokedexText`

- `dlg_6bb9b39460fcaa0c` · menu · — · When it curls up in a ball, it can make any ⏎ attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has ⏎ turned tough and solid as a result of ⏎ living in the desert.

### `gSandslashPokedexText`

- `dlg_3bb02cd1169633bf` · menu · — · It curls up in a ball to protect itself from ⏎ enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent ⏎ heatstroke during the daytime when ⏎ temperatures rise sharply.

### `gNidoranFPokedexText`

- `dlg_f08a3f265c082e24` · menu · — · Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have ⏎ developed as protection for this small- ⏎ bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases ⏎ a horrible toxin from its horn.

### `gNidorinaPokedexText`

- `dlg_8713ab8c6db273b8` · menu · — · When it is with its friends or ⏎ family, its barbs are tucked away to ⏎ prevent injury. It appears to become ⏎ nervous if separated from the others.

### `gNidoqueenPokedexText`

- `dlg_76ce3713180fed6d` · menu · — · It is adept at sending foes flying with ⏎ harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. ⏎ This POKéMON is at its strongest when ⏎ it is defending its young.

### `gNidoranMPokedexText`

- `dlg_67e7cafd0c39cf80` · menu · — · The male NIDORAN has developed muscles ⏎ that freely move its ears in any direction. ⏎ Even the slightest sound does not escape ⏎ this POKéMON's notice.

### `gNidorinoPokedexText`

- `dlg_f9db4d4bfa147399` · menu · — · Its horn is harder than a diamond. ⏎ If it senses a hostile presence, all the ⏎ barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it ⏎ challenges the foe with all its might.

### `gNidokingPokedexText`

- `dlg_3376cc20ffaf2998` · menu · — · A NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously ⏎ destructive power capable of toppling ⏎ a metal transmission tower. Once it goes ⏎ on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

### `gClefairyPokedexText`

- `dlg_2b85be23cf420e6f` · menu · — · On every night of a full moon, they come ⏎ out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired ⏎ CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against ⏎ each other in deep and quiet mountains.

### `gClefablePokedexText`

- `dlg_d0797057c1dedd71` · menu · — · A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly  ⏎ as if it were flying. Its bouncy step ⏎ lets it even walk on water. On quiet, ⏎ moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

### `gVulpixPokedexText`

- `dlg_b41b068acb4ead30` · menu · — · It can freely control fire, making fiery ⏎ orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just ⏎ before evolution, its six tails grow hot  ⏎ as if on fire.

### `gNinetalesPokedexText`

- `dlg_333b8273a758e974` · menu · — · It has long been said that each of the ⏎ nine tails embody an enchanted power. ⏎ A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that ⏎ shines like gold.

### `gJigglypuffPokedexText`

- `dlg_c16dfbd756db2237` · menu · — · Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a ⏎ JIGGLYPUFF's song. The sound waves of its ⏎ singing voice match the brain waves of ⏎ someone in a deep sleep.

### `gWigglytuffPokedexText`

- `dlg_1fe76fbaf812da34` · menu · — · Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. ⏎ Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply ⏎ divine. Its body expands seemingly without ⏎ end when it inhales.

### `gZubatPokedexText`

- `dlg_716c7c3c72b4f31b` · menu · — · While living in pitch-black caverns, their ⏎ eyes gradually grew shut and deprived ⏎ them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves ⏎ to detect obstacles.

### `gGolbatPokedexText`

- `dlg_485ae49f6c43184b` · menu · — · Its fangs easily puncture even thick ⏎ animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood ⏎ of people and POKéMON. It flits about in ⏎ darkness and strikes from behind.

### `gOddishPokedexText`

- `dlg_01ffd70c7c4a18e0` · menu · — · This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. ⏎ During the daytime, it buries itself in the ⏎ ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to ⏎ avoid detection by its enemies.

### `gGloomPokedexText`

- `dlg_675e2aa831a91dc4` · menu · — · A horribly noxious honey drools from its ⏎ mouth. One whiff of the honey can result ⏎ in memory loss. Some fans are said to ⏎ enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

### `gVileplumePokedexText`

- `dlg_90ada0c265206547` · menu · — · In seasons when it produces more pollen, ⏎ the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow ⏎ with the powder as it walks. The pollen is ⏎ highly toxic and causes paralysis.

### `gParasPokedexText`

- `dlg_bf37afa7090e35d8` · menu · — · A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso ⏎ mushrooms growing on its back. They grow ⏎ by drawing nutrients from the host. They ⏎ are valued as a medicine for long life.

### `gParasectPokedexText`

- `dlg_e31f7b2f9c7dec1d` · menu · — · PARASECT are known to infest the roots of ⏎ large trees en masse and drain nutrients. ⏎ When an infested tree dies, they move ⏎ onto another tree all at once.

### `gVenonatPokedexText`

- `dlg_ad5ca1b73658f8c4` · menu · — · Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers ⏎ its entire body is said to have evolved ⏎ for protection. Its large eyes never fail ⏎ to spot even miniscule prey.

### `gVenomothPokedexText`

- `dlg_6632aed3ec7c1e66` · menu · — · VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are ⏎ active at night. Their favorite prey are ⏎ insects that gather around streetlights, ⏎ attracted by the light in the darkness.

### `gDiglettPokedexText`

- `dlg_1d895691803002c9` · menu · — · DIGLETT are raised in most farms. ⏎ The reason is simple--wherever they ⏎ burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled ⏎ for growing delicious crops.

### `gDugtrioPokedexText`

- `dlg_18a633bd1ed0e074` · menu · — · Because the triplets originally split from ⏎ one body, they think exactly alike. ⏎ They work cooperatively to burrow ⏎ endlessly through the ground.

### `gMeowthPokedexText`

- `dlg_ada6dc8af475042b` · menu · — · MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into ⏎ their paws to silently sneak about. ⏎ For some reason, this POKéMON loves ⏎ shiny coins that glitter with light.

### `gPersianPokedexText`

- `dlg_d7b073c4068e56db` · menu · — · A PERSIAN's six bold whiskers sense air ⏎ movements to determine what is in its ⏎ vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed ⏎ by the whiskers.

### `gPsyduckPokedexText`

- `dlg_640a12da07988017` · menu · — · When its headache intensifies, it starts ⏎ using strange powers. However, it has no ⏎ recollection of its powers, so it always ⏎ looks befuddled and bewildered.

### `gGolduckPokedexText`

- `dlg_fea330228abe3e19` · menu · — · A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. ⏎ It sometimes joins competitive swimmers ⏎ in training. It uses psychic powers when ⏎ its forehead shimmers with light.

### `gMankeyPokedexText`

- `dlg_31ad502e4806d56a` · menu · — · When it starts shaking and its nasal ⏎ breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign ⏎ of anger. However, since this happens ⏎ instantly, there is no time to flee.

### `gPrimeapePokedexText`

- `dlg_3781b6446aa388d6` · menu · — · When it becomes furious, its blood ⏎ circulation becomes more robust, and ⏎ its muscles are made stronger. But it ⏎ also becomes much less intelligent.

### `gGrowlithePokedexText`

- `dlg_cacb597756ac8b29` · menu · — · Its superb sense of smell ensures that ⏎ this POKéMON won't forget any scent, ⏎ no matter what. It uses its sense of smell ⏎ to detect the emotions of others.

### `gArcaninePokedexText`

- `dlg_f3015ca2cf4a775b` · menu · — · This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run ⏎ over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. ⏎ The fire that blazes wildly within its body ⏎ is its source of power.

### `gPoliwagPokedexText`

- `dlg_442941edf2eef66b` · menu · — · It is possible to see this POKéMON's spiral ⏎ innards right through its thin skin. ⏎ However, the skin is also very flexible. ⏎ Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

### `gPoliwhirlPokedexText`

- `dlg_a97a6af846d4f0b5` · menu · — · Its body surface is always wet and slick ⏎ with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy ⏎ covering, it can easily slip and slide out ⏎ of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

### `gPoliwrathPokedexText`

- `dlg_305597c1ed6cf804` · menu · — · Its highly developed muscles never grow ⏎ fatigued, however much it exercises. ⏎ This POKéMON can swim back and forth ⏎ across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

### `gAbraPokedexText`

- `dlg_ea33549240d7fdb9` · menu · — · A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. ⏎ Observation revealed that it uses ⏎ TELEPORT to change its location once ⏎ every hour.

### `gKadabraPokedexText`

- `dlg_58af1a6e4399a475` · menu · — · It is rumored that a boy with psychic ⏎ abilities suddenly transformed into ⏎ KADABRA while he was assisting research ⏎ into extrasensory powers.

### `gAlakazamPokedexText`

- `dlg_3cf8a07d24cf291d` · menu · — · While it has strong psychic abilities and ⏎ high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM's muscles ⏎ are very weak. It uses psychic power to ⏎ move its body.

### `gMachopPokedexText`

- `dlg_80ef2609c84f96b4` · menu · — · It continually undertakes strenuous ⏎ training to master all forms of martial ⏎ arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist ⏎ a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

### `gMachokePokedexText`

- `dlg_ca794077ea597352` · menu · — · A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its ⏎ overwhelming power under control. ⏎ Because it is so dangerous, no one has ⏎ ever removed the belt.

### `gMachampPokedexText`

- `dlg_fcc37ec1c2a0aa74` · menu · — · It is impossible to defend against punches ⏎ and chops doled out by its four arms. ⏎ Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces ⏎ a tough opponent.

### `gBellsproutPokedexText`

- `dlg_7241e16094032b25` · menu · — · A BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body lets ⏎ it bend and sway to avoid any attack, ⏎ however strong it may be. From its mouth, ⏎ it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

### `gWeepinbellPokedexText`

- `dlg_38b59ea439036019` · menu · — · At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree ⏎ branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. ⏎ If it moves around in its sleep, it may ⏎ wake up to find itself on the ground.

### `gVictreebelPokedexText`

- `dlg_5f7282c62c47298e` · menu · — · The long vine extending from its head is ⏎ waved about as if it were a living thing to ⏎ attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim ⏎ approaches, it is swallowed whole.

### `gTentacoolPokedexText`

- `dlg_63ec0b906c20c872` · menu · — · Its body is almost entirely composed of ⏎ water. It ensnares its foe with its two ⏎ long tentacles, then stabs with the poison ⏎ stingers at their tips.

### `gTentacruelPokedexText`

- `dlg_3639243ef848a712` · menu · — · It lives in complex rock formations on ⏎ the ocean floor and traps prey using its ⏎ 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it ⏎ grows excited or agitated.

### `gGeodudePokedexText`

- `dlg_e91811c6a257b615` · menu · — · It climbs mountain paths using only the ⏎ power of its arms. Because they look just ⏎ like boulders lining paths, hikers may step ⏎ on them without noticing.

### `gGravelerPokedexText`

- `dlg_eed3bba0d57ef13e` · menu · — · They descend from mountains by tumbling ⏎ down steep slopes. They are so brutal, ⏎ they smash aside obstructing trees and ⏎ massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

### `gGolemPokedexText`

- `dlg_f5fc385774a5c223` · menu · — · It is said to live in volcanic craters ⏎ on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds ⏎ its hide and grows larger. The shed hide ⏎ crumbles and returns to the soil.

### `gPonytaPokedexText`

- `dlg_7421d4c2304284c2` · menu · — · A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can ⏎ barely stand up. Its legs become stronger ⏎ as it stumbles and falls while trying to ⏎ keep up with its parent.

### `gRapidashPokedexText`

- `dlg_681dab358657a96b` · menu · — · It usually canters casually in the fields ⏎ and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns ⏎ serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze ⏎ as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

### `gSlowpokePokedexText`

- `dlg_fd5a928d52bc1bba` · menu · — · It catches prey by dipping its tail in ⏎ water at the side of a river. But it often ⏎ forgets what it is doing and spends entire ⏎ days just loafing at water's edge.

### `gSlowbroPokedexText`

- `dlg_af11cb6f784e1ede` · menu · — · Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached ⏎ with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be ⏎ used for fishing anymore. This forces it ⏎ to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

### `gMagnemitePokedexText`

- `dlg_8c64265525602860` · menu · — · The units at its sides are extremely ⏎ powerful magnets. They generate enough ⏎ magnetism to draw in iron objects from ⏎ over 300 feet away.

### `gMagnetonPokedexText`

- `dlg_5aa743479f4d2950` · menu · — · It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked ⏎ by magnetism. It generates powerful radio ⏎ waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 ⏎ degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

### `gFarfetchdPokedexText`

- `dlg_bbb6aabcb7289c7f` · menu · — · It is always seen with a stick from a plant. ⏎ Apparently, there are good sticks and bad ⏎ sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights ⏎ with others over choice sticks.

### `gDoduoPokedexText`

- `dlg_a4196dd32e7a52c9` · menu · — · Even while eating or sleeping, one of the ⏎ heads remains always vigilant for any sign ⏎ of danger. When threatened, it flees at ⏎ over 60 miles per hour.

### `gDodrioPokedexText`

- `dlg_de31622b05b2cfc1` · menu · — · A peculiar POKéMON species with three ⏎ heads. It vigorously races across grassy ⏎ plains even in arid seasons with little ⏎ rainfall.

### `gSeelPokedexText`

- `dlg_d110a54bb9e075ea` · menu · — · SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered ⏎ seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches ⏎ a hole through the ice with the sharply ⏎ protruding section of its head.

### `gDewgongPokedexText`

- `dlg_edcd26148f243d40` · menu · — · It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. ⏎ The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on ⏎ a glacier was mistakenly thought to be ⏎ a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

### `gGrimerPokedexText`

- `dlg_f380cc4951df5406` · menu · — · Born from polluted sludge in the sea, ⏎ GRIMER's favorite food is anything filthy. ⏎ They feed on wastewater pumped out from ⏎ factories.

### `gMukPokedexText`

- `dlg_a4b6f08465daddb3` · menu · — · It prefers warm and humid habitats. ⏎ In the summertime, the toxic substances ⏎ in its body intensify, making MUK reek like ⏎ putrid kitchen garbage.

### `gShellderPokedexText`

- `dlg_686d4899c2643bb3` · menu · — · At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor ⏎ with its broad tongue to make a place to ⏎ sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, ⏎ but leaves its tongue hanging out.

### `gCloysterPokedexText`

- `dlg_acae37928d04ca96` · menu · — · It swims in the sea by swallowing water, ⏎ then jetting it out toward the rear. ⏎ The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its ⏎ shell using the same system.

### `gGastlyPokedexText`

- `dlg_70177ad44f6a8853` · menu · — · When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's ⏎ gaseous body quickly dwindles away. ⏎ They cluster under the eaves of houses ⏎ to escape the ravages of wind.

### `gHaunterPokedexText`

- `dlg_87c7d7537f7d3237` · menu · — · If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is ⏎ floating in darkness, don't approach it. ⏎ This POKéMON will try to lick you with its ⏎ tongue and steal your life away.

### `gGengarPokedexText`

- `dlg_f270a8954683029c` · menu · — · Deep in the night, your shadow cast by ⏎ a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. ⏎ It is actually a GENGAR running past ⏎ you, pretending to be your shadow.

### `gOnixPokedexText`

- `dlg_391444916a073187` · menu · — · There is a magnet in its brain that ⏎ prevents an ONIX from losing direction ⏎ while tunneling. As it grows older, its body ⏎ becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

### `gDrowzeePokedexText`

- `dlg_e358f57bc34b5a05` · menu · — · If your nose becomes itchy while you are ⏎ sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is ⏎ standing above your pillow and trying to ⏎ eat your dream through your nostrils.

### `gHypnoPokedexText`

- `dlg_e3c55b1abe31dfc7` · menu · — · The arcing movement and glitter of the ⏎ pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe ⏎ into deep hypnosis. While searching for ⏎ prey, it polishes the pendulum.

### `gKrabbyPokedexText`

- `dlg_d36e84582a736857` · menu · — · KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. ⏎ On sandy shores with little in the way ⏎ of food, they can be seen squabbling with ⏎ each other over territory.

### `gKinglerPokedexText`

- `dlg_ba98d909a969b138` · menu · — · It waves its huge, oversized claw in the ⏎ air to communicate with others. ⏎ But since the claw is so heavy, this ⏎ POKéMON quickly tires.

### `gVoltorbPokedexText`

- `dlg_769a10b7a1cf0ab3` · menu · — · It bears an uncanny and unexplained ⏎ resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it ⏎ explodes at the slightest shock, even ⏎ veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.

### `gElectrodePokedexText`

- `dlg_8e6ab121e37978e1` · menu · — · They appear in great numbers at electric ⏎ power plants. Because they feed on ⏎ electricity, they cause massive and ⏎ chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

### `gExeggcutePokedexText`

- `dlg_5e412c696882b801` · menu · — · It consists of six eggs that care for each ⏎ other. The eggs attract each other and ⏎ spin around. When cracks increasingly ⏎ appear, it is close to evolution.

### `gExeggutorPokedexText`

- `dlg_bdfe80e40a9a6007` · menu · — · Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's ⏎ heads grow larger from exposure to strong ⏎ sunlight. It is said that when the heads ⏎ fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.

### `gCubonePokedexText`

- `dlg_67eff0d0995f99c9` · menu · — · It pines for the mother it will never see ⏎ again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in ⏎ the full moon, it cries. The stains on the ⏎ skull it wears are from its tears.

### `gMarowakPokedexText`

- `dlg_c54dda9a1e5da6d2` · menu · — · A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE ⏎ that has grown tough by overcoming the ⏎ grief of losing its mother. Its tempered ⏎ and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

### `gHitmonleePokedexText`

- `dlg_1837a5dc750f9748` · menu · — · Its legs freely stretch and contract. ⏎ Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over ⏎ foes with devastating kicks. After battle, ⏎ it rubs down its tired legs.

### `gHitmonchanPokedexText`

- `dlg_aba866d3d0a7fbbf` · menu · — · A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the ⏎ spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the ⏎ world champion. Having an indomitable ⏎ spirit means that it will never give up.

### `gLickitungPokedexText`

- `dlg_817454bb0d403f68` · menu · — · Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, ⏎ it always licks the object because it ⏎ memorizes things by texture and taste. ⏎ It is somewhat put off by sour things.

### `gKoffingPokedexText`

- `dlg_2c78dc270e027e84` · menu · — · Getting up close to a KOFFING will give ⏎ you a chance to observe, through its thin ⏎ skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It ⏎ blows up at the slightest stimulation.

### `gWeezingPokedexText`

- `dlg_e6feba51b469d00c` · menu · — · By diluting its toxic gases with a special ⏎ process, the highest grade of perfume can ⏎ be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating ⏎ from garbage are the ultimate feast.

### `gRhyhornPokedexText`

- `dlg_833384ebef0136fd` · menu · — · Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. ⏎ Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it ⏎ can't remember why it started running in ⏎ the first place.

### `gRhydonPokedexText`

- `dlg_87650413ded8d57e` · menu · — · Its horn, which rotates like a drill, ⏎ destroys tall buildings with one strike. ⏎ It stands on its hind legs, and its brain ⏎ is well developed.

### `gChanseyPokedexText`

- `dlg_fd64b22092114bf6` · menu · — · CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs ⏎ every day. The eggs are so delicious, they ⏎ are eagerly devoured by even those people ⏎ who have lost their appetite.

### `gTangelaPokedexText`

- `dlg_d3e9b1fe7af5f08a` · menu · — · Its vines snap off easily and painlessly ⏎ if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a ⏎ quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced ⏎ by new growth the very next day.

### `gKangaskhanPokedexText`

- `dlg_5289732c3aecfec2` · menu · — · If you come across a young KANGASKHAN ⏎ playing by itself, never try to catch it. ⏎ The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, ⏎ and it will become violently enraged.

### `gHorseaPokedexText`

- `dlg_4a09c3da6a886718` · menu · — · By cleverly flicking the fins on its back ⏎ side to side, it moves in any direction ⏎ while facing forward. It spits ink to ⏎ escape if it senses danger.

### `gSeadraPokedexText`

- `dlg_c4eca8cea2184a2d` · menu · — · The poisonous barbs all over its body are ⏎ highly valued as ingredients for making ⏎ traditional herbal medicine. It shows no ⏎ mercy to anything approaching its nest.

### `gGoldeenPokedexText`

- `dlg_095b3b13e1459750` · menu · — · In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN ⏎ can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. ⏎ It metes out staggering damage with its ⏎ single horn.

### `gSeakingPokedexText`

- `dlg_33a37e40c567e405` · menu · — · It punches holes in boulders on stream- ⏎ beds. This is a clever innovation that ⏎ prevents its eggs from being attacked or ⏎ washed away by the current.

### `gStaryuPokedexText`

- `dlg_98c52676a90b6956` · menu · — · It gathers with others in the night and ⏎ makes its red core glow on and off with ⏎ the twinkling stars. It can regenerate ⏎ limbs if they are severed from its body.

### `gStarmiePokedexText`

- `dlg_2eba860ca8a9193d` · menu · — · People in ancient times imagined that ⏎ STARMIE were transformed from the ⏎ reflections of stars that twinkled on ⏎ gentle waves at night.

### `gMrMimePokedexText`

- `dlg_8eedef53924e2c5c` · menu · — · A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can ⏎ convince others that something unseeable ⏎ actually exists. Once believed, the ⏎ imaginary object does become real.

### `gScytherPokedexText`

- `dlg_8e8e9d3b8b19a825` · menu · — · Its blindingly fast speed adds to the ⏎ sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. ⏎ The scythes can slice through thick logs ⏎ in one wicked stroke.

### `gJynxPokedexText`

- `dlg_60584f26ab7a2fad` · menu · — · A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were ⏎ dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly ⏎ alluring, people seeing it are compelled to ⏎ shake their hips without noticing.

### `gElectabuzzPokedexText`

- `dlg_9b908842784d498e` · menu · — · When a storm approaches, it competes with ⏎ others to scale heights that are likely to ⏎ be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ⏎ ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.

### `gMagmarPokedexText`

- `dlg_0d71cf923f01ad63` · menu · — · In battle, it blows out intense flames from ⏎ all over its body to intimidate its foe. ⏎ These fiery bursts create heat waves that ⏎ ignite grass and trees in the area.

### `gPinsirPokedexText`

- `dlg_c806c7d471de7927` · menu · — · Their pincers are strong enough to ⏎ shatter thick logs. Because they dislike ⏎ cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under ⏎ the ground on chilly nights.

### `gTaurosPokedexText`

- `dlg_b55c7374a3a2c20e` · menu · — · It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging ⏎ at all times. If there is no opponent for ⏎ TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick ⏎ trees and knock them down to calm itself.

### `gMagikarpPokedexText`

- `dlg_795aea0687827ad6` · menu · — · Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is ⏎ easily washed away by currents. In places ⏎ where water pools, you can see many ⏎ MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.

### `gGyaradosPokedexText`

- `dlg_39641330ad50c095` · menu · — · It is an extremely vicious and violent ⏎ POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, ⏎ it will appear and burn everything to the ⏎ ground with intensely hot flames.

### `gLaprasPokedexText`

- `dlg_cc9632eccfcc99cc` · menu · — · People have driven LAPRAS almost to the ⏎ point of extinction. In the evenings, ⏎ it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks ⏎ what few others of its kind still remain.

### `gDittoPokedexText`

- `dlg_c7b4b9d9a308ab79` · menu · — · A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to ⏎ transform itself. However, if it tries to ⏎ change based on its memory, it will get ⏎ details wrong.

### `gEeveePokedexText`

- `dlg_b4673fcd2e87b87f` · menu · — · An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup ⏎ that suddenly mutates due to its ⏎ environment. Radiation from various ⏎ STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.

### `gVaporeonPokedexText`

- `dlg_f2b8b4d096ec6e77` · menu · — · VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous ⏎ mutation and grew fins and gills that ⏎ allow them to live underwater. They have ⏎ the ability to freely control water.

### `gJolteonPokedexText`

- `dlg_19d39f846bf15010` · menu · — · Its cells generate weak power that is ⏎ amplified by its fur's static electricity ⏎ to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is ⏎ made of electrically charged needles.

### `gFlareonPokedexText`

- `dlg_9b2a96c766d48c33` · menu · — · FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into ⏎ the air so that its body does not get ⏎ excessively hot. Its body temperature can ⏎ rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

### `gPorygonPokedexText`

- `dlg_2314681acf19524c` · menu · — · It is capable of reverting itself entirely ⏎ back to program data in order to enter ⏎ cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy- ⏎ protected so it cannot be duplicated.

### `gOmanytePokedexText`
