- `dlg_a560e3ffa52ab432` · menu · — · Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. ⏎ In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the ⏎ bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it ⏎ continually feeds throughout the night.

### `gCorphishPokedexText`

- `dlg_0f10ac0c09b6aea0` · menu · — · Once it grips prey with its large pincers, ⏎ it will never let go, no matter what. ⏎ It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive ⏎ in any environment.

### `gCrawdauntPokedexText`

- `dlg_1ac4b2e0f67763b1` · menu · — · A brutish POKéMON that loves to battle. ⏎ A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in ⏎ hundreds of battles has giant pincers ⏎ marked with countless scars.

### `gBaltoyPokedexText`

- `dlg_f74d5d0523308732` · menu · — · A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single ⏎ foot. It has been depicted in murals  ⏎ adorning the walls of a once-bustling city ⏎ in an ancient age.

### `gClaydolPokedexText`

- `dlg_d020ffc3040b9880` · menu · — · A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. ⏎ Its arms are separate from its body. ⏎ They are kept floating by the POKéMON's ⏎ manipulation of psychic power.

### `gLileepPokedexText`

- `dlg_7ce48cfd0f49a1d5` · menu · — · It disguises itself as seaweed by making ⏎ its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey ⏎ that come too close are swallowed whole. ⏎ It became extinct 100 million years ago.

### `gCradilyPokedexText`

- `dlg_cc228a63d79ce8be` · menu · — · It drags its heavy body along the ⏎ seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows ⏎ of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on ⏎ beaches when the tide goes out.

### `gAnorithPokedexText`

- `dlg_e5be0192801d7406` · menu · — · It was resurrected from a fossil using the ⏎ power of science. It swims by undulating ⏎ the eight wings at its sides. They were ⏎ feet that adapted to life in the sea.

### `gArmaldoPokedexText`

- `dlg_86eda11897b45740` · menu · — · ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, ⏎ when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath ⏎ the ocean. It swims around using its two ⏎ large wings.

### `gFeebasPokedexText`

- `dlg_a021ec73cca065d3` · menu · — · FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily ⏎ infested with weeds. Because of its ⏎ hopelessly shabby appearance, it ⏎ seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.

### `gMiloticPokedexText`

- `dlg_8945a1bbafc6caed` · menu · — · It is said to live at the bottom of ⏎ large lakes. Considered to be the most ⏎ beautiful of all POKéMON, it has been ⏎ depicted in paintings and statues.

### `gCastformPokedexText`

- `dlg_998f6df939c19c3a` · menu · — · It alters its form depending on the ⏎ weather. Changes in the climate such as ⏎ the temperature and humidity appear to ⏎ affect its cellular structure.

### `gKecleonPokedexText`

- `dlg_f60deea03ea4650f` · menu · — · A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its ⏎ body colors to match its surroundings. ⏎ A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if ⏎ it is startled.

### `gShuppetPokedexText`

- `dlg_928aa9ffab490dd8` · menu · — · This POKéMON roams about deep in the ⏎ night seeking such negative emotions as ⏎ grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest ⏎ when the sun begins to rise.

### `gBanettePokedexText`

- `dlg_50e2ac8586d84266` · menu · — · An abandoned plush doll became this ⏎ POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage ⏎ dumps and wander about in search of the ⏎ children that threw them away.

### `gDuskullPokedexText`

- `dlg_6b440befceae1463` · menu · — · A glare from its single scarlet eye makes ⏎ even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. ⏎ It is a nocturnal POKéMON that roams ⏎ about under the cloak of darkness.

### `gDusclopsPokedexText`

- `dlg_9640fce88f708837` · menu · — · It is thought that its body is hollow with ⏎ only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. ⏎ However, no one has been able to ⏎ confirm this theory as fact.

### `gTropiusPokedexText`

- `dlg_8c2575ff5b762b19` · menu · — · It flies by flapping its broad leaves. ⏎ The bunch of fruit that grows around its ⏎ neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, ⏎ it scatters pollen from its neck.

### `gChimechoPokedexText`

- `dlg_9c96e2b082e73ac4` · menu · — · They fly about very actively when the hot ⏎ season arrives. They communicate among ⏎ themselves using seven different and ⏎ distinguishing cries.

### `gAbsolPokedexText`

- `dlg_7d26c457354d380e` · menu · — · It sharply senses even subtle changes in ⏎ the sky and the land to predict natural ⏎ disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that ⏎ has a life-span of 100 years.

### `gWynautPokedexText`

- `dlg_ca51c57fc6b3b410` · menu · — · A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. ⏎ It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike ⏎ arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn ⏎ by the fragrance.

### `gSnoruntPokedexText`

- `dlg_bcea9f69a45dbea5` · menu · — · They tend to move about in groups of ⏎ around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, ⏎ it is said that when they are seen late at ⏎ night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

### `gGlaliePokedexText`

- `dlg_1c09aa20154edb10` · menu · — · A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously ⏎ freeze moisture in the atmosphere. ⏎ A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice ⏎ crystals forms around its body.

### `gSphealPokedexText`

- `dlg_75e708bc79fd0ba7` · menu · — · It is completely covered with plushy fur. ⏎ As a result, it never feels the cold even ⏎ when it is rolling about on ice floes or ⏎ diving in the sea.

### `gSealeoPokedexText`

- `dlg_d46e236fe22281df` · menu · — · SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its ⏎ powerful flippers, it shatters ice. ⏎ It dives into the sea to hunt prey five ⏎ times a day.

### `gWalreinPokedexText`

- `dlg_1126b54741e6e4a7` · menu · — · To protect its herd, the leader battles ⏎ anything that invades its territory, even ⏎ at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap ⏎ off in battle.

### `gClamperlPokedexText`

- `dlg_e2a777adb560f5c6` · menu · — · A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey ⏎ to prevent escape. The pearl it creates ⏎ upon evolution is said to be infused with ⏎ a mysterious energy.

### `gHuntailPokedexText`

- `dlg_5d9dc3d627fea2cd` · menu · — · To withstand the crushing pressure of ⏎ water deep under the sea, its spine is very ⏎ thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped ⏎ like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

### `gGorebyssPokedexText`

- `dlg_b9f9aa39c38e043e` · menu · — · A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey ⏎ through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light ⏎ pink body color turns vivid when it ⏎ finishes feeding.

### `gRelicanthPokedexText`

- `dlg_e9d982b60fa1932c` · menu · — · A POKéMON that was once believed to have ⏎ been extinct. The species has not changed ⏎ its form for 100 million years. It walks on ⏎ the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

### `gLuvdiscPokedexText`

- `dlg_789c0be8bf579688` · menu · — · LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA ⏎ their nests. There is a custom from long ⏎ ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to ⏎ express one's feelings of love.

### `gBagonPokedexText`

- `dlg_196916983d9bd2c3` · menu · — · Although it is small, this POKéMON is very ⏎ powerful because its body is a bundle of ⏎ muscles. It launches head-butts with its ⏎ ironlike skull.

### `gShelgonPokedexText`

- `dlg_c29ef4f7e81a2bf5` · menu · — · It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. ⏎ It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. ⏎ Its shell peels off the instant it begins ⏎ to evolve.

### `gSalamencePokedexText`

- `dlg_eecc447627d1bd5d` · menu · — · After many long years, its cellular ⏎ structure underwent a sudden mutation to ⏎ grow wings. When angered, it loses all ⏎ thought and rampages out of control.

### `gBeldumPokedexText`

- `dlg_8a8b198ca1528d49` · menu · — · When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move ⏎ in perfect unison as if they were but one ⏎ POKéMON. They communicate with each other ⏎ using brain waves.

### `gMetangPokedexText`

- `dlg_9fce1fabd852a338` · menu · — · The claws tipping its arms pack the ⏎ destructive power to tear through thick ⏎ iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies ⏎ at over 60 miles per hour.

### `gMetagrossPokedexText`

- `dlg_60e463b015d5fd70` · menu · — · METAGROSS has four brains that are joined ⏎ by a complex neural network. As a result of ⏎ integration, this POKéMON is smarter than ⏎ a supercomputer.

### `gRegirockPokedexText`

- `dlg_e8cdea42a6f6408e` · menu · — · A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks ⏎ and boulders. If parts of its body chip off ⏎ in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by ⏎ adding new rocks.

### `gRegicePokedexText`

- `dlg_ec686c78c1e81310` · menu · — · Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. ⏎ After extensive studies, researchers ⏎ believe the ice was formed during an ⏎ ice age.

### `gRegisteelPokedexText`

- `dlg_5cb2dca624bbe7fa` · menu · — · Its body is harder than any other kind of ⏎ metal. The body metal is composed of a ⏎ mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, ⏎ it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

### `gLatiasPokedexText`

- `dlg_8e0f097c10f577cf` · menu · — · They make a small herd of only several ⏎ members. They rarely make contact with ⏎ people or other POKéMON. They disappear ⏎ if they sense enemies.

### `gLatiosPokedexText`

- `dlg_8e8e2a37ac7aab2a` · menu · — · Even in hiding, it can detect the locations ⏎ of others and sense their emotions since ⏎ it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows ⏎ it to understand human languages.

### `gKyogrePokedexText`

- `dlg_6428f66847a02289` · menu · — · KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the ⏎ creator of the sea. After long years of ⏎ feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at ⏎ the bottom of the sea.

### `gGroudonPokedexText`

- `dlg_42d4434100d5b1af` · menu · — · GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the ⏎ creator of the land. It sleeps in magma ⏎ underground and is said to make volcanoes ⏎ erupt on awakening.

### `gRayquazaPokedexText`

- `dlg_bafcf70e57715f0e` · menu · — · A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the ⏎ ozone layer. It is said it would descend ⏎ to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON ⏎ were to fight.

### `gJirachiPokedexText`

- `dlg_5afb09f06428ea67` · menu · — · JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. ⏎ While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell ⏎ envelops the body to protect it from ⏎ enemies.

### `gDeoxysPokedexText`

- `dlg_96d2e4cdf20f4bf0` · menu · — · A POKéMON that mutated from an ⏎ extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser ⏎ beam. Its body is configured for superior ⏎ agility and speed.
